title: Org chart levels
statementMd:
Compute each employee's level in the reporting tree: top managers (no manager) are level 1, their direct reports level 2, and so on. Show first name and level.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `level`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: A recursive CTE starts from employees with `manager_id IS NULL` and joins children each step.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH RECURSIVE tree(id, first_name, level) AS (SELECT id, first_name, 1 FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.id, e.first_name, t.level + 1 FROM employees e JOIN tree t ON e.manager_id = t.id) SELECT first_name, level FROM tree;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
